newsitem.title: USA: US West Coast prods prices flat amid muted trade.
newsitem.headline: US West Coast prods prices flat amid muted trade.

text.p: U.S. West Coast spot product prices ended the day flat Thursday amid muted activity a day following Christmas.
NYMEX saw January gasoline ease 0.05 cents to 69.51 while front-month heating oil dropped 1.34 cents a gallon to 70.06 cents.
Bids for Los Angeles unleaded CARB gasoline remained 74 cents a gallon, while offers stayed 75 cents.
CARB diesel held at 73/74 cents a gallon, and "EPA" quality diesel was unchanged at 71/72 cents.
